verdict.rationale: Opting out of a vendor's own telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS monitoring platform with SDKs and an MCP server, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented opt-out of Raygun's own telemetry or usage tracking. The closest items, filtering sensitive fields before errors are sent and the 'Disable IP address storage' flag, are adjacent controls over the error data a customer's application sends. They are not a user opt-out of Raygun's own tracking, so they earn no credit.
